witnesses.title: Antimeridian discontinuity in a short track (naive vs unwrapped midpoint)
witnesses.input_justification: Two track vertices 0.02° apart across the antimeridian (Fiji region): the canonical coordinate-domain discontinuity named in the brief.
witnesses.expected_behavior: Naive linear midpoint of longitude lands near lon 0° (~half the globe away); longitude unwrapping (+360° before averaging, then re-wrapping) yields lon ≈ -180° and the true short path; haversine arithmetic (stdlib math only) quantifies the detour.
witnesses.stdout:
naive midpoint lon: 0.0
proper midpoint lon (wrapped to [-180,180]): -180.0
true segment length (km): 2.127
path length through naive midpoint (km): 32469.0
path length through proper midpoint (km): 2.127
naive/proper detour ratio: 15267.1
witnesses.scope_limits: Pure arithmetic demonstration of the hazard; validates no product code, no real projection library, no rendering path. Product antimeridian splitting remains proposed/UNEXECUTED.

witnesses.title: Divergent-copy merge: LWW silent loss vs explicit three-way conflict + uncommitted classification

data.copy_a: r1 rev4 'trees dense, canopy 80%' + new r2 + uncommitted draft r4
data.copy_b: r1 rev4 'trees sparse, canopy 30%' + new r3

witnesses.input_justification: Minimal two-copy divergence over the same field (the brief's 'combine a colleague's changed project copy' case) plus an interrupted/draft record to exercise reopen classification.
witnesses.expected_behavior: Last-writer-wins silently discards one side's note; explicit base-vs-(A,B) field comparison emits exactly one inspectable conflict entry preserving base/copy_a/copy_b, keeps the committed base value pending resolution, and classifies the draft (rev 0, no commit marker) as uncommitted at reopen.

witnesses.scope_limits: Synthetic dict-based model in stdlib only; no SQLite, no oplog persistence, no crash injection. Demonstrates the merge semantics contract proposed in §7 of the research proposal; the product merge engine and recovery path remain proposed/UNEXECUTED (validation items 3–4).
